# Code of Conduct

This project follows a simple code of conduct. We expect everyone — contributors, maintainers, and users — to adhere to it.

- Be respectful. Disagreements happen. Personal attacks and dismissive remarks do not belong here.
- Assume good intent. Most misunderstandings come from miscommunication, not malice.
- No harassment. This includes DMs, issues, PRs, and any other project channels.
- Keep it professional. Critique ideas, not people.

Report violations to [dipak@coderstm.com](mailto:dipak@coderstm.com). Reports are handled confidentially.
